{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = sales_df.isnull().sum()

# Check for duplicates
duplicates = sales_df.duplicated().sum()

# Check the unique values in the 'status' column
status_counts = sales_df['status'].value_counts()

# Check the unique values in the 'channel' column
channel_counts = sales_df['channel'].value_counts()

# Check the unique values in the 'customer_segment' column
segment_counts = sales_df['customer_segment'].value_counts()

# Check the unique values in the 'converted' column
converted_counts = sales_df['converted'].value_counts()

# Check the distribution of revenue
revenue_stats = sales_df['revenue'].describe()

# Check if there are any test orders (likely identifiable by order_id pattern or status)
# Looking at the order_id, test orders might be prefixed or have unusual patterns
order_id_prefixes = sales_df['order_id'].str[:3].value_counts()

# Print results
missing_values, duplicates, status_counts, channel_counts, segment_counts, converted_counts, revenue_stats, order_id_prefixes"}
